arxiv-2106-14679.title: Permanent variational wave functions for bosons
arxiv-2106-14679.creator: J. M. Zhang, H. F. Song, Y. Liu
arxiv-2106-14679.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by J. M. Zhang, H. F. Song, Y. Liu. We study the performance of permanent states (the bosonic counterpart of the Slater determinant state) as approximating functions for bosons, with the intention to develop variational methods based upon them. For a system of N N identical bosons, a permanent state is constructed by taking a set of N N arbitrary (not necessarily orthonormal) single-particle orbitals, forming their product and then symmetrizing it.

arxiv-2212-10819.title: Attend to the Right Context: A Plug-and-Play Module for Content-Controllable Summarization
arxiv-2212-10819.creator: Wen Xiao, Lesly Miculicich Yang Liu
arxiv-2212-10819.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Wen Xiao, Lesly Miculicich Yang Liu. Content-Controllable Summarization generates summaries focused on the given controlling signals. Due to the lack of large-scale training corpora for the task, we propose a plug-and-play module RelAttn to adapt any general summarizers to the content-controllable summarization task. RelAttn first identifies the relevant content in the source documents, and then makes the model attend to the right context by directly steering the attention weight.

arxiv-2310-10614.title: Understanding an Acquisition Function Family for Bayesian Optimization
arxiv-2310-10614.creator: Jiajie Kong, Tony Pourmohamad, Herbert K. H. Lee
arxiv-2310-10614.description: Abstract Bayesian optimization (BO) developed as an approach for the efficient optimization of expensive black-box functions without gradient information. A typical BO paper introduces a new approach and compares it to some alternatives on simulated and possibly real examples to show its efficacy. Yet on a different example, this new algorithm might not be as effective as the alternatives.

arxiv-2310-11482.title: Rethinking Class-incremental Learning in the Era of Large Pre-trained Models via Test-Time Adaptation
arxiv-2310-11482.creator: Imad Eddine Marouf, Subhankar Roy, Stéphane Lathuilière, Enzo Tartaglione
arxiv-2310-11482.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Imad Eddine Marouf, Subhankar Roy, Stéphane Lathuilière, Enzo Tartaglione. Class-incremental learning (CIL) is a challenging task that involves sequentially learning to categorize classes from new tasks without forgetting previously learned information. The advent of large pre-trained models (PTMs) has fast-tracked the progress in CIL due to the highly transferable PTM representations, where tuning a small set of parameters leads to state-of-the-art performance when compared with the traditional CIL methods that are trained from scratch.

arxiv-2402-06619.title: Aya Dataset: An Open-Access Collection for Multilingual Instruction Tuning
arxiv-2402-06619.creator: name=Shivalika Singh \fa, affiliation=1, name=Freddie Vargus \fa, affiliation=1, name=Daniel D’souza \fa, affiliation=1, name=Börje F. Karlsson \fa, affiliation=2, name=Abinaya Mahendiran \fa, affiliation=1, name=Wei-Yin Ko \fa, affiliation=3, name=Herumb Shandilya \fa, affiliation=1, name=Jay Patel
arxiv-2402-06619.description: Abstract Datasets are foundational to many breakthroughs in modern artificial intelligence. Many recent achievements in the space of natural language processing (NLP) can be attributed to the fine-tuning of pre-trained models on a diverse set of tasks that enables a large language model (LLM) to respond to instructions. Instruction fine-tuning (IFT) requires specifically constructed and annotated datasets.

arxiv-2408-07643.title: Influence of disordered and anisotropic interactions on relaxation dynamics and propagation of correlations in tweezer arrays of Rydberg dipoles
arxiv-2408-07643.creator: K. Mukherjee, G. W. Biedermann, R. J. Lewis-Swan
arxiv-2408-07643.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by K. Mukherjee, G. W. Biedermann, R. J. Lewis-Swan. We theoretically investigate the out-of-equilibrium dynamics of irregular one- and two-dimensional arrays of Rydberg dipoles featuring spatially anisotropic interactions. Starting from a collectively polarized initial state, we map out the dynamical phase diagram and identify a crossover between regimes of regular and anomalously slow relaxation of the initial collective order, that strongly depends on both the degree of interaction disorder and anisotropy.

arxiv-2409-06757.title: Electronic State Population Dynamics upon Ultrafast Strong Field Ionization and Fragmentation of Molecular Nitrogen
arxiv-2409-06757.creator: Carlo Kleine, Marc-Oliver Winghart, Zhuang-Yan Zhang, Maria Richter, Maria Ekimova, Sebastian Eckert, Edward R. Grant, Marc J. J. Vrakking, Erik T. J. Nibbering, Arnaud Rouzée
arxiv-2409-06757.description: Abstract Air-lasing from single ionized N + 2 {}_{2}^{+} molecules induced by laser filamentation in air has been intensively investigated and the mechanisms responsible for lasing are currently highly debated. We use ultrafast nitrogen K-edge spectroscopy to follow the strong field ionization and fragmentation dynamics of N 2 upon interaction with an ultrashort 800 nm laser pulse.

arxiv-2411-15224.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Seokil Ham, Hee-Seon Kim, Sangmin Woo, Changick Kim, Korea Advanced Institute of Science, Technology (KAIST). Despite the growing interest in Mamba architecture as a potential replacement for Transformer architecture, parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) approaches for Mamba remain largely unexplored.

arxiv-2501-18368.creator: Fabian Zierler
arxiv-2501-18368.description: Abstract We study the scattering of two identical pNGBs ( p seudo- N ambu- G oldstone B osons) in S ​ p ​ ( 4 ) Sp(4) gauge theory with two mass-degenerate Dirac fermions in the pseudo-real fundamental representation. This theory serves as a realization of a SIMP ( S trongly I nteracting M assive P articles) Dark Matter model.

arxiv-2502-15845.title: Verify when Uncertain: Beyond Self-Consistency in Black Box Hallucination Detection
arxiv-2502-15845.creator: Yihao Xue, Kristjan Greenewald, Youssef Mroueh, Baharan Mirzasoleiman
arxiv-2502-15845.description: Abstract Large Language Models (LLMs) suffer from hallucination problems, which hinder their reliability in sensitive applications. In the black-box setting, several self-consistency-based techniques have been proposed for hallucination detection. We empirically study these techniques and show that they achieve performance close to that of a supervised (still black-box) oracle, suggesting little room for improvement within this paradigm.

pmc-10667030.title: Understanding ethnic diversity in open dementia neuroimaging data sets
pmc-10667030.creator: Nicholas Yew Wei Heng, Timothy Rittman
pmc-10667030.description: Ethnic differences in dementia are increasingly recognized in epidemiological measures and diagnostic biomarkers. Nonetheless, ethnic diversity remains limited in many study populations. Here, we provide insights into ethnic diversity in open-access neuroimaging dementia data sets. Data sets comprising dementia populations with available data on ethnicity were included. Statistical analyses of sample and effect sizes were based on the Cochrane Handbook.

pmc-10738222.title: THE CELL “SURFACEOME”: A STRATEGY TO TARGET SENESCENT CELLS IN VIVO
pmc-10738222.creator: Reema Banarjee, Amit Dey, Thedoe Nyunt, Jordan Gregg, Dimitrios Tsitsipatis, Allison Herman, Myriam Gorospe, Nathan Basisty
pmc-10738222.description: Senescent cell accumulation drives aging and related pathologies including metabolic disorders and neurodegeneration, and their selective elimination is a promising therapeutic approach to treat multiple diseases of aging in humans. However, developing drugs to eliminate senescent cells requires specific biomarkers to selectively identify and target these cells in vivo.

pmc-11503076.title: From fibrositis to fibromyalgia to nociplastic pain: how rheumatology helped get us here and where do we go from here?
pmc-11503076.creator: Daniel J Clauw
pmc-11503076.description: Rheumatologists and rheumatology have had a prominent role in the conceptualisation of nociplastic pain since the prototypical nociplastic pain condition is fibromyalgia. Fibromyalgia had been previously known as fibrositis, until it became clear that this condition could be differentiatied from autoimmune disorders because of a lack of systemic inflammation and tissue damage.

pmc-11562644.title: Development and validation of a tumor marker-based model for the prediction of lung cancer: an analysis of a multicenter retrospective study in Shanghai, China
pmc-11562644.creator: Sheng Hu, Qiang Guo, Jiayue Ye, Hongdan Ma, Manyu Zhang, Yunzhe Wang, Bingen Wan, Shengyu Qiu, Xinliang Liu, Guiping Luo, Wenxiong Zhang, Dongliang Yu, Jianjun Xu, Yiping Wei, Linxiang Zeng
pmc-11562644.description: BackgroundThe incidence and mortality rates of cancer are the highest globally. Developing novel methodologies that precisely, safely, and economically differentiate between benign and malignant lung conditions holds immense clinical importance. This research seeks to construct a predictive model utilizing a combination of diverse biomarkers to effectively discriminate between benign and malignant lung diseases.

pmc-11608843.title: Efficacy of controlled‐release dinoprostone vaginal insert for elective induction of labor before due date
pmc-11608843.creator: Junko Tamai, Satoru Ikenoue, Keisuke Akita, Yuka Fukuma, Yuya Tanaka, Keita Hasegawa, Toshimitsu Otani, Yoshifumi Kasuga, Mamoru Tanaka
pmc-11608843.description: AimThe induction of labor before due date has recently been proved to reduce the rate of cesarean sections and is not associated with increased risk of adverse perinatal outcomes as compared to expectant management. Controlled‐release dinoprostone (PGE2) vaginal insert has recently been approved for use in Japan.

pmc-11635313.title: Preliminary Screening for Hereditary Breast and Ovarian Cancer Using an AI Chatbot as a Genetic Counselor: Clinical Study
pmc-11635313.creator: Ann Sato, Eri Haneda, Yukihiko Hiroshima, Hiroto Narimatsu, Amaryllis Mavragani, Lei Guo, Lucas Garcia
pmc-11635313.description: BackgroundHereditary breast and ovarian cancer (HBOC) is a major type of hereditary cancer. Establishing effective screening to identify high-risk individuals for HBOC remains a challenge. We developed a prototype of a chatbot system that uses artificial intelligence (AI) for preliminary HBOC screening to determine whether individuals meet the National Comprehensive Cancer Network BRCA1/2 testing criteria.

pmc-13159204.title: Neonatal conjunctivitis due to uncommon pathogen Streptococcus mitis/oralis: a case report
pmc-13159204.creator: Ali Kutay Kılınç, Nezihat Desen Büyüksoy, Yağmur Seda Yeşiltaş, Aylin Üner Bozdayı
pmc-13159204.description: Neonatal conjunctivitis (NC), historically attributed to Neisseria gonorrhoeae, is now known to be caused by various pathogens, including Staphylococcus, Streptococcus, and Chlamydia trachomatis. Although viridans group streptococci are generally regarded as commensal organisms, they may cause opportunistic conjunctival infections. Here, we present a case of NC caused by Streptococcus mitis/oralis, a member of the Mitis group of viridans group streptococci.
